name: wayfinder-routing
description: Runtime gate ordering for the wayfinder lane, ordered by real dependency rather than by cost. harness_gate feeds skills_gate because catalog roots are harness-specific (engine/catalog.py NATIVE_ROOTS). skills_gate does not depend on model_route_gate or swarm_decision_gate: model tier shapes the answer, not the search, and orchestration strategy is orthogonal to which skills are relevant. Those two are therefore siblings of harness_gate, not predecessors of skills_gate.

nodes.summary: A prompt arrives from a harness.
Determine which harness and adapter shape this prompt belongs to.
nodes.pass_condition: Prompt normalizes to a known harness
nodes.why: Load-bearing for skills_gate: roots_for() returns different catalog roots per harness, so ranking before harness resolution would search the wrong catalog.

nodes.summary: Route the task to a tier-appropriate model for the response.
nodes.pass_condition: A tier is resolved (exit 0); an empty model id means the Hermes profile's configured model
nodes.fail_action: Treat as default tier; do not block the prompt
nodes.why: Sibling of harness_gate, not a predecessor of skills_gate. Tier selection changes how the model answers; it does not change which skills are applicable.

nodes.summary: Decide whether this task warrants formal swarm orchestration.
nodes.pass_condition: Not applicable; this gate is four-way by nature
nodes.why: Sibling of harness_gate. Orchestration strategy is orthogonal to skill relevance, and when a swarm is engaged the skill assessment runs per workstream inside the swarm rather than being replaced by this verdict.

nodes.summary: Assess whether the catalog holds skills applicable to this task.
nodes.pass_condition: A pick clears the local rank threshold
nodes.why: Depends on harness_gate only. Placing it after model_route_gate or swarm_decision_gate would assert a dependency the code does not have and serialize work that is genuinely independent.

nodes.summary: Emit the advisory note, or continue without one. All three verdicts are in hand; the response is composed once.
nodes.fail_action: none; this is the terminal state
